description: Data model + store foundation + full persistence wiring. Adds TodoEdge.color and the TodoZone entity, R3 new-node default dimensions, R2 edge-color persistence + the setSelectionColor batch action, and the R4 todoZones store slice (create/update/delete/move). CRITICAL: every new persisted field is routed through ALL its whitelists so nothing is silently dropped on load/import/restore. This feature must land first — FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on these types, constants, and actions. It is NOT independent of the later features (they consume it).
steps: src/types.ts: add `color?: string` to `TodoEdge` (comment: uppercase hex; undefined => LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR). Add the new `TodoZone` interface { id; x; y; width; height; color: string; name: string } exactly as in design.md 'Data model changes'. In `AppState` add `todoZones: TodoZone[]` plus the five action signatures verbatim from design.md 'AppState additions': createTodoZone(bounds:{x;y;width;height}) => string | null; updateTodoZone(zoneId, updates: Partial<Pick<TodoZone,'x'|'y'|'width'|'height'|'color'|'name'>>) => void; deleteTodoZone(zoneId) => void; moveTodoZone(zoneId, dx, dy, nodeTargets: Record<string,{x;y}>) => void; setSelectionColor(nodeIds: string[], edgeIds: string[], color: string) => void.

src/store.ts constants: near the top-level color maps (e.g. after TASK_COLOR_HEX ~line 190) add `export const THEME_COLOR = '#8D78D5';` and `export const LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR = '#9B8AE4';` (UPPERCASE — they must be byte-identical to normalizeHexColor output), plus `const DIRECTORY_MIN_WIDTH = 176; const DIRECTORY_MIN_HEIGHT = 48; const NODE_DEFAULT_WIDTH = DIRECTORY_MIN_WIDTH; const NODE_DEFAULT_HEIGHT = DIRECTORY_MIN_HEIGHT * 2;` (176 / 96).

src/store.ts R3: in `createTodoItem` (~line 1132) add `width: NODE_DEFAULT_WIDTH, height: NODE_DEFAULT_HEIGHT` to the pushed item object (it currently sets color:'indigo' and no width/height). In `toggleTodoItemDirectory` (~line 1345) replace the literal 176/48 in the clamp with DIRECTORY_MIN_WIDTH / DIRECTORY_MIN_HEIGHT (identical numeric behavior, avoids drift).

src/store.ts R2 persistence: in `normalizeTodoEdges` (~line 259) change the final push to also carry color when present: `return [{ id, laneId: candidate.laneId, sourceItemId: candidate.sourceItemId, targetItemId: candidate.targetItemId, ...(typeof candidate.color === 'string' ? { color: candidate.color } : {}) }];`

src/store.ts R2 action: add `setSelectionColor: (nodeIds, edgeIds, color) => persistSet((state) => ({ todoItems: state.todoItems.map(i => new Set(nodeIds).has(i.id) ? { ...i, color } : i), todoEdges: state.todoEdges.map(e => new Set(edgeIds).has(e.id) ? { ...e, color } : e) }))` (build the Sets once outside the maps). ONE persistSet => one undo step.

src/store.ts R4 normalize: add `const normalizeTodoZones = (value: unknown): TodoZone[] => {...}` mirroring normalizeTodoSections/normalizeTodoEdges style: reject non-array; per entry require x/y/width/height all finite numbers else skip; de-dupe ids (prefix `todo-zone-` + genId()); width/height clamped `Math.max(1, ...)`; `color: normalizeHexColor(c.color, THEME_COLOR)`; `name: typeof c.name === 'string' ? c.name : ''`.

src/store.ts R4 load/seed: add `const initialTodoZones = savedState ? normalizeTodoZones(savedState.todoZones) : [];` near the other initial* consts (~line 673); add `todoZones: normalizeTodoZones(parsed.todoZones)` to the object returned by `loadSavedState` (the big return ~line 533+); seed `todoZones: initialTodoZones,` in the store's returned state object next to `todoEdges: initialTodoEdges` (~line 858). Note savedState already carries the normalized value, so initialTodoZones can read savedState.todoZones directly.

src/store.ts R4 actions: add createTodoZone (top guard: if any of x/y/width/height not finite OR width<1 OR height<1 return null; else persistSet append `{ id: 'todo-zone-'+genId(), ...bounds, color: THEME_COLOR, name: '' }` and return id), updateTodoZone (persistSet map merge by id), deleteTodoZone (persistSet filter by id — MUST NOT touch todoItems), moveTodoZone (persistSet: map todoZones moving the one zone by dx/dy AND map todoItems applying nodeTargets[id] positions — both in the SAME persistSet for one undo step).

src/store.ts persistence whitelists for todoZones (do ALL — none deferred): add `todoZones: state.todoZones,` to `persistState.toSave` (~line 784); add `| 'todoZones'` to the `HistorySnapshot` Pick (~line 705); add `'todoZones'` to the `HISTORY_KEYS` Set (~line 728); add `todoZones: state.todoZones,` to `captureHistorySnapshot` (~line 737); add `todoZones: normalizeTodoZones(data.todoZones),` to the object returned by `restoreFromBackup` (~line 1098, alongside todoLanes/todoItems/todoEdges). Edge color needs NO key changes (rides inside the existing todoEdges entry; normalizeTodoEdges is its only whitelist, done above).
acceptance_criteria: A throwaway `npx tsx` script importing the store module (or the exported normalize helpers) confirms: a saved-state blob containing one zone (with a non-default color + non-empty name) and one edge carrying a color survives a JSON round-trip through the load/normalize path with zone color byte-identical to '#8D78D5' when defaulted (and the custom color + name preserved), and the edge color preserved.
createTodoItem-produced items carry width 176 and height 96 (verified via tsx calling the action or asserting NODE_DEFAULT_WIDTH/HEIGHT); pre-existing items are unaffected.

createTodoZone returns null for width 0 / non-finite bounds and otherwise appends a zone whose color equals THEME_COLOR; deleteTodoZone removes only the zone and leaves todoItems unchanged; moveTodoZone mutates zone position and the supplied nodeTargets in one persistSet.
THEME_COLOR === '#8D78D5' and LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR === '#9B8AE4' (uppercase), and both are exported.
verification: Write a temp script under the worktree (e.g. /Users/cici/Desktop/project/Planner/.worktrees/board-zones/.agents/tasks/_tmp_feat001.ts) that exercises normalizeTodoZones + normalizeTodoEdges + createTodoZone/deleteTodoZone semantics and the persistence round-trip (construct toSave-equivalent, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(...)), re-normalize, assert equality of zone color+name and edge color). Run `npx tsx .agents/tasks/_tmp_feat001.ts`, confirm all assertions pass, then delete the temp script.

Record in `findings` the exact file + line of each of the three persistence whitelists edited (toSave, HistorySnapshot/HISTORY_KEYS/captureHistorySnapshot, restoreFromBackup) plus normalizeTodoEdges + normalizeTodoZones, so FEAT-003 and the reviewer can confirm nothing was missed.
findings: All edits in src/store.ts (line numbers after edits). PERSISTENCE WHITELISTS: (1) persistState.toSave -> todoZones added at store.ts:824. (2) HistorySnapshot Pick -> '| todoZones' at store.ts:753; HISTORY_KEYS Set -> 'todoZones' at store.ts:768; captureHistorySnapshot -> todoZones: state.todoZones at store.ts:786. (3) restoreFromBackup returned object -> todoZones: normalizeTodoZones(data.todoZones) at store.ts:1156. NORMALIZE HELPERS: normalizeTodoEdges edited to carry edge color at store.ts:287 (helper defined at store.ts:266); normalizeTodoZones defined at store.ts:292. LOAD/SEED WIRING: loadSavedState return -> todoZones: normalizeTodoZones(parsed.todoZones) at store.ts:622; initialTodoZones = savedState ? normalizeTodoZones(savedState.todoZones) : [] at store.ts:712; store state seed -> todoZones: initialTodoZones at store.ts:899. CONSTANTS: THEME_COLOR='#8D78D5' and LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR='#9B8AE4' (both exported, UPPERCASE) plus DIRECTORY_MIN_WIDTH/HEIGHT + NODE_DEFAULT_WIDTH(176)/HEIGHT(96) added after TASK_COLOR_HEX. R3: createTodoItem now sets width:176/height:96; toggleTodoItemDirectory clamp uses the named constants (same 176/48 behavior). R4 ACTIONS at store.ts:1431-1455: createTodoZone (degenerate-bounds guard -> null), updateTodoZone, deleteTodoZone (does NOT touch todoItems), moveTodoZone (zone + nodeTargets in one persistSet), setSelectionColor (nodes+edges in one persistSet = one undo step). types.ts: TodoEdge.color? + TodoZone interface + AppState.todoZones + 5 action signatures. edge.color needs no key changes (rides inside todoEdges; normalizeTodoEdges is its only whitelist). VERIFICATION: npm run lint exits 0; throwaway npx tsx script (created under worktree, deleted) asserted constants, 176x96 node defaults, createTodoZone null-guards + THEME_COLOR default, deleteTodoZone leaves items intact, moveTodoZone zone+node shift, setSelectionColor node+edge, and a full localStorage load/normalize round-trip preserving zone custom color (uppercased #1A2B3C), defaulted zone color byte-identical to #8D78D5, zone name, and edge color #ABCDEF — all passed.
